answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: each must lock a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs. A clone fleet shows up as a correlated delta in funding and timing, flagged like a bright comet against a dark sky, and every fake must sink its own collateral plus wait a vesting window. So faking a thousand names costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow seasons; honest standing accrues quietly, drop by drop, like an ocean filling. Sybil cost scales linearly.
